title: Chicken and Chorizo Rice
seoTitle: Chicken and Chorizo Rice | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: One-pot saffron rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, and peas
subtitle: One-pot saffron rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, and peas
description: Chicken thighs and chorizo cook with bomba or short-grain rice, saffron, bell pepper, and peas into a fragrant one-pot crew dinner.

steps.title: Bloom saffron
steps.instruction: Steep saffron in warm broth 10 minutes until liquid turns golden and smells distinctly floral and earthy.

steps.title: Crisp chorizo and brown chicken
steps.instruction: Cook chorizo in Dutch oven until fat renders and edges crisp. Remove. Brown chicken thighs in chorizo fat 4 minutes per side until golden.

steps.title: Build rice base
steps.instruction: Sauté onion and pepper 5 minutes. Add garlic, paprika, and rice. Toast 2 minutes until rice edges look translucent and smell nutty.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.instruction: Add saffron broth, nest chicken and chorizo on top. Simmer covered 25–30 minutes without stirring until rice absorbs liquid and is tender.

steps.title: Add peas and rest
steps.instruction: Stir in peas off heat, cover 5 minutes. Rice should be fluffy with slight socarrat crust at bottom if heat was even.

proTips: Wide pot is essential—deep narrow pots cook unevenly.
Lemon wedges at the line brighten rich chorizo fat.
Substitute andouille if Spanish chorizo unavailable—adjust salt.
tonightSpread: Simple green salad with sherry vinaigrette.
leftovers: Reheat covered with splash of broth to restore moisture.
Arancini-style balls from leftover rice—deep fry or bake.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Bold Spanish flavors feel like a special occasion. One pot means one cleanup after a long shift.
mealPrepNotes: Bloom saffron in warm broth 10 minutes before cooking. Use wide Dutch oven for even rice. Station: Do not stir rice after initial mix—stirring releases starch and makes mush. Station: Crisp chorizo first and reserve fat for browning chicken. Station: Rest pot 5 minutes covered off heat before serving for fluffy rice.
